decisions.reason: After several years with no visible follow-up, this conferencing offer looks less central to the firm's infrastructure-led strategy, so even with some sunk-cost reluctance management is likely to reallocate resources to stronger core and new development areas.

This metro data-centre connectivity network matches the firm's owned infrastructure, cloud and data-centre direction and already showed concrete adoption, making management likely to continue backing it despite limited recent visibility.

Optical spectrum connectivity remains closely tied to the firm's fibre-based high-bandwidth strategy and earlier public commitment, so management is inclined to persist and interpret weak visibility as temporary or as integration into broader solutions.
